---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
labels: type/feature, status/needs-review
---

## Pre-flight

- [ ] I searched [existing issues](https://github.com/ChivukulaVirinchi/photovault/issues?q=is%3Aissue) and [Discussions](https://github.com/ChivukulaVirinchi/photovault/discussions) for the same idea.
- [ ] The feature fits Smriti's offline-first scope (no cloud dependency).

## What problem does this solve?

Describe the user need — who hits it, when, and how often. If you
can, explain why the current workflow doesn't solve it.

## Proposed solution

How you would like it to work. A mockup or ASCII sketch helps.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, and why the proposed one is
better.

## Additional context

Links to related issues, prior art in other photo apps, screenshots.
